sections.heading: Maria Vorontsova — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Maria Vorontsova was born on 28 April 1985 in Saint Petersburg, and holds Russian nationality. She was given the name Мария Владимировна Путина at birth and is publicly known as Maria Vorontsova.
Public records name her father, Vladimir Putin and her mother, Lyudmila Ocheretnaya. She is a sibling of Katerina Tikhonova.
She studied at Faculty of Biology, Saint Petersburg State University, MSU Faculty and German School Moscow.
She is recorded as speaking Russian and German.

sections.heading: Maria Vorontsova — Career and Professional Work
paras: Maria Vorontsova works primarily as an endocrinologist, biologist, geneticist and lecturer, with Endocrinology Research Centre and MSU Faculty listed among her employers.
